items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: We did this in Jersey, on Verve with Creed Taylor.

ctx.x: When was -- which was that, which album was that?
This was -- let's see, Strayhorn and all the whole band was there. Oh, boy. We did this in Jersey, on Verve with Creed Taylor.
That wasn't, 'Duke's In Bed,' that was done in Chicago, wasn't it?
